So, I was loving Textra, and then they went ad-supported - good for them. I loved the app, but decided to try out google messenger before shelling out for the paid version. Well, I loved messenger, and it works really nicely with google keyboard, so I have been using it for, I don't know a couple of months? One thing I noticed was that my pictures in messenger were still being backed up into the textra folder in gallery. That's great! I don't have to worry about saving pictures! Well, one night my wife wanted to send herself a picture from my phone and she picked textra and made it the default app again. There they were - all the texts I had sent for months just sitting in textra - all the ones I had deleted from messenger. So I went into textra and wiped everything. Of course, that wiped everything in messenger, too! I just ended up uninstalling textra completely. Maybe this is common knowledge around here, but I am an android noob so I thought I would share.

Tl;dr - Textra will run in the background and save all your texts even when it isn't default
